plain: This story is about a man named John Harrington and a gap in the government's records. Brent Friedman, a guest on a podcast about Hollywood and UFOs, says that David Grusch, a government whistleblower, told him that they had picked out Harrington as a very important person who remembers a period whose paperwork no longer exists. A second guest, Bryce Zabel, says that according to Grusch, many documents went missing from the years when Harrington worked in President Reagan's administration, and he mentions the House Oversight Committee, a group in Congress that investigates the government. Friedman tells it again in a later episode as part of a call about how to approach Harrington. People tell it because, if true, Harrington's memory could fill in UFO history that the paper trail has lost.
